question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution prohibits trafficking in human beings and forced labour?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 23**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Article 23** of the Indian Constitution explicitly prohibits **trafficking in human beings, "begar" (forced labour), and other similar forms of forced exploitation.**
 
• This provision is a part of the **Fundamental Rights** under the Indian Constitution, ensuring the protection of individual dignity and liberty.
